description: Add, change, or translate user-facing text in the Lyrion Dashboard, which ships bilingual FR/EN. Use this whenever a task introduces a new visible string (a label, tooltip, aria-label, empty state, stat name), changes wording, or touches the README or a `docs/` page — so every string lands in both languages and the EN/FR documentation pairs stay in sync. Covers `i18n.py`, how templates and JS consume translations, and the parity rule.
